author: sonnet
label: climb-03-01
changes: Added a short 'what this is' summary and a Terms block (broker, publisher confirmation, 30 s redelivery, MailRelay accept and idempotency, flag, relay, reconciler) to the one-page design, for Q3, Q4, Q5.
Step 3: defined svc_notifications status values (pending, sent, failed), who changes each, when attempts is incremented and when a row becomes sent, for Q1 and Q2.
Step 3: defined 'due' as status pending and next_attempt_at <= now, and that a backoff row is simply left alone, for Q1.
Step 3 Consumer: said how a new id, an in-progress id and a terminal id are handled and that attempts and next_attempt_at from the message apply only on first insert, for Q7.
Step 4 Relay: said it reads the flag per type each poll and filters by the service type list, and what happens if the relay is stopped or slow, for Q5 and Q6.
Step 4 Reconciler: spelled out the three outcomes in the service (never seen, still retrying, terminal), for Q7.
Added an Open questions section noting that flag ownership and whether MailRelay delivery is synchronous are unknown and not needed by the plan.
Reordered into the newcomer layout: two-paragraph summary, terms, numbered steps, one failure table, open questions; the diagram now sits after the terms.
Merged the separate Ownership, Handoff, Return path, Two layers, Flags and Messages sections into the Terms list, and removed the duplicated handoff and return-path prose that the steps repeat.
Folded the retry policy into the terms so steps no longer restate it.
Removed 'see Step 3/4/5' cross-references: steps 5 to 7 now say 'as in step 5' once and step 5 spells out its failures and rollback itself.
Cut the 'Exit:' lines of steps 1, 2 and 3 where they only repeated the deploy condition, and trimmed 'Exit' wording elsewhere.
Dropped the 'Failure and rollback' repetition in step 8 and the 'a week later the old behavior is gone' exit.
Shortened step 7 safeguards and the latency-measurement note; removed the 'at least 3 full days' repetition of the p99 retry commentary.
Kept all mechanisms and gates unchanged (outbox, relay, reconciler, key on both senders, flag per type, 3/3/7 day gates, p99 under 60 s).
